effect: The fragments gathered into larger aggregates while some smaller debris remained, completing the final goal.
reaction: The mixed outcome was satisfying: not all the debris simply became one body.

mostWorthwhile.text: Forming the moon was the strongest passage: the same struck world survived, while debris gathered into a moon or fell back or escaped.

leastWorthwhile.text: The later fragment sequence felt somewhat repetitive, with several successive encounters and only one combination offered at each decision.

surprise.text: The crossing rocky body broke apart the coated rubble; I had expected it to incorporate some material instead.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the fragment sequence offered little meaningful choice once it began.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see where the surviving world and debris go, though I hope for more meaningful choices.
